CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  July 21, 2025

The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – July 21, 2025
  (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – July 21, 2025 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:02 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Ho

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Principal Planner; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Karabeth
  Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – JULY 7, 2025 (7:03 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the July 7, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the July 7, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1 with a revision to include
  an added reference in the motion for Agenda Item 4 specifying that
  the recommended amendments are in the Resolution.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-2-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Gardea, Juarez
  Absent:  Ho

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – FEBRUARY 7, 2022 (7:09 P.M.)

  1
  07/21/2025
   •  Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the February 7, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the February 7, 2022, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Dorado
  Absent:  Ho

E.  RE-ORDER THE AGENDA (7:10 P.M.)

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to re-order the Agenda to take the Public Hearing first,
  followed by the Discussion Item.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President
  Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Ho

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-24-01 (7:11 P.M.)
  • 422 South Eighth Street
  • This is an application for a Planned Development Permit to allow
  for the construction of a second floor second unit attached to a
  proposed Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) and garage at the rear
  of an existing single-family residence located at 422 South Eighth
  Street within the RH (Residential High Density) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-06, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-24-01 to allow for the
  construction of a second floor second unit, located at 422 South
  Eighth Street within the RH (Residential High Density) zone, and
  finding Planned Development Permit PD-24-01 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15303, Class 3 of Title 14 of the California

  2
  07/21/2025
   Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects
  consisting of new construction or conversion of small structures.
  •  Senior Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Bertha Rivera

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Juarez, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Ho

G.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  PLANNING COMMISSIONER TRAINING AND HOUSING LAW
  UPDATE (7:36 P.M.)
  • This is a report to inform the Planning Commission about their
  roles and responsibilities; the Brown Act for open meetings for
  local legislative bodies in California; and State housing laws.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report.
  • Deputy City Attorney Erica Vega provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Alborz Montashami
  2.) Lewis McCammon
  3.) Melissa Michelson

H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

I.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  There were no comments from the Planning Commission or Conference/Meeting
  Reports.

J.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  There were no comments from staff.
